This hunk is the pre-gh-1248 inlined `_parseJson`/`_toArray`/`_cleanCommandOutput`. The branch never touched `scm.js` (last branch-side touch: none — `git log e60d05ee -- js/common/scm.js` shows only pre-gh-1248 history), so the merge conflict was resolved by taking "ours" and silently reverted a merged main PR.

Verified consequences (duplication gate reproduced byte-for-byte locally with the pinned tool `IstiN/crap4js@83ee6201`, same command as `quality.yml`):

```
fresh duplication: js/common/githubReviewFetch.js 24.74% (not pinned in duplication-baseline.json)
fresh duplication: js/factory/publishParams.js 5.48% (not pinned in duplication-baseline.json)
duplication regression: js/factory/review_verdict_publish.js 6 -> 8 duplicated lines
duplication regression: js/factory/token_usage_publish.js 6 -> 8 duplicated lines
duplication ratchet: FAIL — 3 fresh, 2 regressed
```

`githubReviewFetch.js` is over threshold **only because** this file re-inlined the exact blocks it delegates to on main (clones at `githubReviewFetch.js:27-36 ↔ scm.js:376-383`, `:46-54 ↔ scm.js:385-391`, `:68-72 ↔ scm.js:357-360`). ```bash
git fetch origin main
git checkout origin/main -- js/common/scm.js

```bash
